svg.title: TTT derivation schematic
svg.text: How the isothermal transformation (TTT) data are generated (D3-s3, D3-s4, D3-s5)
Sample structure in the 1300 °F bath, and after the quench (labels as on the slide)
A = austenite, P = pearlite, M = martensite (letters not defined on the slide).
* slide prints "75M + 5P": treated as a typo for 75M + 25P.
Percent pearlite vs time at the bath temperature
Points use the sample numbers and percentages from the table; curve shape is schematic.
